name: collect_oak_logs

steps.description: Observe surroundings to identify visible blocks and find oak_log.
steps.verification: result contains 'oak_log' in visible block names

steps.description: Move towards the detected oak log using screen coordinates.
Look at the specific log block to ensure accurate targeting.
Break a second oak log if available nearby.

preconditions: Agent must be within pathfinding range of an oak tree.
Agent must have clear line of sight to the tree trunk.
successCriteria: Inventory contains at least one oak_log.
failureModes: No oak_log visible in the initial observation.
dig_screen fails to break the block (e.g., out of reach or incorrect tool).
